What should I do if the tracking never updates?

Sent · Just now

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

If your tracking information is not updating, please follow these steps:

Check your tracking details for any transit delays or notes about your order arriving in separate packages, especially if items were sourced from multiple locations.
If it has been more than 24 hours past the estimated delivery date shown in your tracking, contact our Customer Care team by email at customer.services@barkersonline.co.nz, by phone at 09 304 2776, or via live chat.
If you received a tracking email, use the DHL or NZ Post tracking links to monitor your parcel and, where possible, arrange redelivery or rerouting for missed deliveries.
If you have not received a tracking email, check your spam or junk folder. If it is still missing, please contact support.
If your tracking shows the parcel as delivered but you have not received it, contact support so we can investigate with the courier. If you have already started an investigation, please include your case number.
